name: Python SDK for MS fabric REST APIs
description: The Fabric REST API provides developers with programmatic access to manage and interact with Microsoft Fabric resources. It enables developers to automate a wide array of tasks, including data integration, data warehousing, big data analytics, deployment process automation, new tenant provisioning, and more.The Python SDK is a wrapper library that simplifies the communication with the Fabric REST API and handles the authentication, serialization, and error handling for you.
